correctness.rationale: Integration against the independent exponential clock gives discounted success u_i(r+s) and discounted reset c(1−u_i(r+s)), where c=r/(r+s). Averaging products over the uniform initial cyclic phase gives the block sum 1−(1−c)Σ_{k≥1}c^{k−1}B_k; iid replaces B_k by the mean failure probability to power k. A full block factors into the product P times shorter blocks. AM–GM bounds P, the symmetric-mean inequality bounds the shorter blocks that are full averages over pairs or triples, and for four modes the adjacent-pair sum factors as (q_1+q_3)(q_2+q_4). Thus B_k ≤ (mean q)^k for every k when m≤4, including q_i=0 or 1, and the full-block comparison is strict for nonconstant q. At s↓0, P(r)<1 by the capture assumption, so blockwise geometric domination in a neighborhood of zero justifies passage to the means after division by s. Independently solved the mode-specific renewal equations F_i=u_i+cq_i F_{i+1} with fractions at the Brownian witness. The cyclic and iid transforms are 2729396/5242745 and 12/23 respectively, with difference −136832/120583135. The distances yield u_i(4)=1/4,1/4,1/4,3/4,3/4 in the stated cyclic order. Strictness gives distinct perturbed sites by continuity. More generally, three consecutive ones and zeros elsewhere give B_2=2/m>9/m² for m≥5; interior perturbation and the uniform O(c²) tail give the claimed small-c reversal and Brownian realizability.
residual_risks: Equality of the free transforms at a single sampled argument gives equality of the comparison there (or of the means at r); equality in law requires transform equality across discounts, not at a single point.
No survival stochastic order or five-mode mean reversal is established. Regenerative independent attempts and uniform initial phase are essential.

evidence: Identical one-attempt marginals produce different multi-attempt failure correlations in the two protocols. A bound on the two-site mean is not a pointwise Laplace inequality. At five sites a cyclic arrangement makes the adjacent-product average exceed the squared mean, despite the full product obeying AM–GM.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: No specialization of the checked iid-location transforms or the two-site mean statement supplies the universal four-site discounted bound or the opposite sign at five. value.rationale: Matching single-attempt marginals do not determine the ordering of the total search time. The sharp cutoff in the number of modes, uniform over free hitting-time laws, gives a reusable policy comparison for regenerative searches; the Brownian counterexample rules out extrapolating it even for standard first-passage laws at finite positive locations. A positive-discount obstruction is informative without claiming a mean or survival reversal.
residual_risks: No extremal result for other cyclic orders or general policies, or for nonregenerative search, is established.
